crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin falls under $70,000 for the first time since August
crypto_headlines.summary: Bitcoin broke below $70,000 Thursday night ET and hit a low of $68,943 on Binance, down about 6% in 24 hours from a high of $73,866, per Wu Blockchain.

crypto_headlines.title: $500 million liquidated in one hour
crypto_headlines.summary: About $500 million in crypto positions were liquidated in an hour as BTC fell under $69,000, ETH under $1,950, XRP under $1.01 and SOL under $80.

crypto_headlines.title: $1.45 billion in longs wiped out as BTC tags $67,500
crypto_headlines.summary: Ash Crypto reported a three-month low of $67,500 for Bitcoin, about $12,500 lower over nine days, with $1.45 billion in long positions liquidated on the day.

crypto_headlines.title: Ethereum whales split as ETH trades near $1,930
crypto_headlines.summary: One whale withdrew 10,380 ETH from Binance while another sold 16,700 ETH at $1,852 for about a $7.7 million loss, with ETH down over 5% in a day.

crypto_headlines.title: Jane Street grows its Fidelity Bitcoin ETF stake nearly 8x
crypto_headlines.summary: Jane Street increased its FBTC share count nearly eightfold in Q3 while trimming its IBIT shares by 19%.

doginal_news.title: Floor steady at 45k DOGE through the selloff
doginal_news.summary: Thursday night the floor was still 45k DOGE (about $2.99k) with the same 17 asks, nothing new listed, and no sale since #495 on Nov 3.

doginal_news.title: "Jawn-ember" hoodie season
doginal_news.summary: The community renamed November "Jawn-ember" and dressed the pixel dogs in hoodies for Type Thursday.

doginal_news.title: RusMetaX wins Legends Arena ROTP
doginal_news.summary: The free-entry Doginal Dogs Legends TCG single-elimination Legends Arena on Thursday night, with a $50 prize, was won by @RusMetaX.

doginal_news.title: "Wall Street looks good on Pyth"
doginal_news.summary: Pyth followed up its NYSE data deal with a push for builders to put the newly available Wall Street data to work.

doginal_news.title: PIRB Friday check-in
doginal_news.summary: PIRB says PYTH is holding up better than the rest of the market, Rule 100 is active with buybacks stacking, and Pyth powers prediction markets including Kalshi and Polymarket.

notes: No new posts from the official Doginal Dogs or DDLTCG accounts in the last day; items come from community posts.
